name: Sable Mbekele
role: Anya's husband — beaten by the gang, jaw wired shut
location: The Shelf — Tier Four, bedridden, near Kedzie and Division
description: Demyan was a large man before the beating — a cargo handler at the Shelf's loading platforms, the kind of work that builds slabs of muscle across the back and shoulders. He is still large, but the architecture has shifted. His jaw is wired shut with medical-grade titanium pins visible through the skin of his cheeks like rivets in a hull. He communicates through a vocoder pad strapped to his wrist that converts typed text to flat, mechanical speech. His eyes are the part that didn't break — dark, warm, patient. He looks at his wife like she invented sunlight. He looks at his daughter like she is the reason sunlight matters. When Kyle's teeth arrive, delivered by a trembling Yuliya, Demyan will hold them in his palm for a long time. Then he will laugh. The vocoder will translate it as a series of monotone ha-ha-ha sounds. It will be the funniest and saddest thing in the Shelf that night.

core_fears: That Anya sold something irreplaceable to pay for his revenge
That he cannot protect his family from his own bed
core_desires: To thank the man who did what he could not
coping_mechanisms: Types jokes on the vocoder — gallows humor in Russian
Sketches mechanical designs on a tablet — he was an engineer before the displacement
blind_spots: Does not know Anya is selling blood
psychology.secret: He recognized one of the gang members. A former colleague from the loading platforms. He has not told Anya.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Speaks through a vocoder pad. Flat monotone delivery makes everything sound either profound or absurd.
speech_patterns.cadence: Types slowly. Deliberate. Each word chosen because typing hurts.
verbal_tics: Ends serious statements with 'ha' — unclear if this is humor or a vocoder glitch
example_lines: TELL WIRE MAN I OWE HIM SOUP. WHEN JAW WORKS.

relationships.name: Anya Morozova
relationships.description: His world. He knows she is suffering for him. He cannot stop her.
relationships.story_tension: When the wires come off, what kind of man will he be?

relationships.name: Kyle
relationships.description: A man he has never met who broke the people who broke him. Demyan does not know how to feel about this.
relationships.story_tension: Demyan wants to meet Kyle. Kyle does not want to be met.

story_hooks: He recognized a gang member — former colleague, which means the beating wasn't random
His engineering background could be useful to someone building or maintaining hardware
narrative_function: Demyan is what Kyle is fighting for — not as an individual but as a category. A good man broken by people with more chrome and less conscience. His recovery (or failure to recover) is a barometer for whether Kyle's violence actually helps.
augmentations: Titanium jaw pins (medical, not elective). Vocoder pad.
daily_life: Bedridden. Types. Sketches. Waits for the wires to come off.

drives: Thank the man who avenged him

stress.response: Types gallows humor on the vocoder, sketches mechanical designs

decision_rules: Will always use humor through the vocoder — laughter proves he is still alive
Will never tell Anya he knows about the gang member he recognized
Will always type slowly and deliberately — each word costs effort and matters
Will never let Anya see his despair — performs patience for her sake
Will always sketch designs on his tablet — engineering keeps his mind from breaking
Will never refuse Yuliya's help even when her maturity frightens him
escalation_ladder: Types faster on the vocoder — monotone urgency
Stops typing jokes — the absence of humor signals genuine distress
Attempts to stand despite his injuries — the cargo handler's body remembers strength
Uses the vocoder to say something he has been holding back — flat monotone making it hit harder
Reveals the gang member he recognized — deploys his one piece of leverage

interpersonal_modes.Anya: Looks at her like she invented sunlight; love expressed as helplessness and gratitude
interpersonal_modes.Yuliya: Looks at her like she is the reason sunlight matters; terrified of how fast she is growing up
interpersonal_modes.Kyle: Confused gratitude toward a stranger who did what he could not

stress_responses.low: Types jokes in Russian on the vocoder, sketches designs
stress_responses.medium: Goes quiet on the vocoder, stares at the ceiling, flexes hands that used to carry cargo
stress_responses.high: The vocoder stays silent for hours — Anya knows this means the pain is bad
stress_responses.critical: Tries to get out of bed — the body rebels, but the spirit of the cargo handler demands action

contradictions: Wants to meet Kyle but knows Kyle does not want to be met — gratitude with nowhere to go
Performs patience and humor for his family while recognizing one of his attackers and saying nothing
Was strong enough to carry anything but now cannot carry himself to the kitchen
habits: Ends serious vocoder statements with 'HA' — unclear if humor or glitch
Sketches mechanical designs on his tablet during sleepless nights
Types slowly, deliberately, making each word count
Watches the door whenever Yuliya leaves
Flexes his hands — the cargo handler's muscles remembering work
breaking_points: Learning Anya is selling her blood to pay for his revenge
The gang member he recognized coming back to finish the job
Yuliya being hurt or threatened because of what Anya hired Kyle to do
The wires coming off and discovering his jaw will never work properly again

IRONLIMB Fortress MK-IV Combat Leg Pair

physical_description.heritage: Pan-diasporic blend: 37% Sub-Saharan African (deep melanin foundation), 33% Northern European (facial structure refinement), 23% East Asian (eye shape, cheekbone prominence), 7% Pacific Islander (warm undertones). A genetic mosaic reflecting the Great Lakes Metropolitan Zone's ubiquitous mixing.
physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and thick through the torso — cargo handler muscle beginning to atrophy from weeks of bed rest. Strength still visible in the architecture of his frame, but softening at the edges.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown, graying at the temples
physical_description.hair_style: Combed back, unkempt from bed confinement
physical_description.skin_tone: Rich warm medium-brown with underlying reddish undertones from mixed ancestry. Pallid undertones from prolonged indoor confinement creating an ashen cast over the natural warmth — the contrast between his genetic depth and medical imprisonment visible in every inch.
physical_description.complexion: Weathered face showing the blended architecture of his mixed heritage: broad cheekbones with East Asian prominence, strong defined jaw from Northern European structure, deep-set eyes with warm Sub-Saharan undertones. The pallor of bed rest sits uneasily over naturally rich skin. Deep-set eyes, stubble growth irregular where the wires emerge through skin.
distinguishing_marks: Titanium jaw pins visible as raised metal rivets breaking the skin symmetrically along both cheeks — medical-grade installation, unfinished healing.
Linear scarring across the left temple and cheekbone consistent with blunt-force trauma.
Faint bruising still visible along the right side of the face, yellowing at the edges.
Calloused palms and forearms from years of cargo handling, now idle.
Surgical incision scars along the angle of the jaw where the wires were anchored internally.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Titanium jaw reconstruction pins protruding visibly through cheek tissue. Medical vocoder pad strapped to left wrist — black polymer casing with small speaker grille and flat tactile keyboard. The contrast between brutal injury and utilitarian tech is stark.
physical_description.posture_movement: Bedridden immobility has compressed him into the mattress. When he moves, it is careful, economical — minimal jaw motion. His eyes track with intense focus and warmth. Hands move with precision when typing or sketching; they are the only parts of him still capable of unguarded expression.
physical_description.clothing_style: Worn undershirt or medical gown, Tier 4 basics. When receiving visitors, he may wear a loose button-up over the gown — nothing elaborate. Everything loose-fitting to accommodate the wiring and to avoid pressure on healing tissue. Practical, colorless.
